-- Copyright (c) 2026 Digital Asset (Switzerland) GmbH and/or its affiliates. All rights reserved.

-- architecture-handbook-entry-begin: PaintDaml
module Paint where

import Daml.Script
import Iou

template PaintHouse
  with
    painter: Party
    houseOwner: Party
  where
    signatory painter, houseOwner

template OfferToPaintHouseByPainter
  with
    houseOwner: Party
    painter: Party
    bank: Party
    amount: Amount
  where
    signatory painter
    observer houseOwner

    choice AcceptByOwner : ContractId Iou
      with
        iouId : ContractId Iou
      controller houseOwner
      do
        iouId2 <- exercise iouId Transfer with newOwner = painter
        paint <- create $ PaintHouse with painter; houseOwner
        return iouId2
-- architecture-handbook-entry-end: PaintDaml

template OfferToPaintHouseByOwner
  with
    houseOwner: Party
    painter: Party
    bank: Party
    iouId: ContractId Iou
  where
    signatory houseOwner
    observer painter

    choice AcceptByPainter : ContractId Iou
      controller painter
        do

testAmountAndIssuance = script do
  bank <- allocateParty "AmountBank"
  alice <- allocateParty "AmountAlice"
  let zero = Amount {value = 0.0; currency = "EUR"}
  let negative = Amount {value = -0.01; currency = "EUR"}
  assert (amountAsText zero == "0.0EUR")
  assert (amountAsText (Amount {value = 12.5; currency = "USD"}) == "12.5USD")
  submitMustFail bank do
    createCmd $ Iou with payer = bank; owner = alice; amount = negative; viewers = []
  submitMustFail alice do
    createCmd $ Iou with payer = bank; owner = alice; amount = zero; viewers = []
  iouId <- submit bank do
    createCmd $ Iou with payer = bank; owner = alice; amount = zero; viewers = []
  found <- queryContractId alice iouId
  case found of
    None -> abort "Owner cannot see issued IOU"
    Some iou -> do
      assert (iou.payer == bank)
      assert (iou.owner == alice)
      assert (iou.amount == zero)
      assert (iou.viewers == [])

testShareAndVisibility = script do
  bank <- allocateParty "ShareBank"
  alice <- allocateParty "ShareAlice"
  bob <- allocateParty "ShareBob"
  carol <- allocateParty "ShareCarol"
  let amount = Amount {value = 37.25; currency = "CHF"}
  iouId <- submit bank do
    createCmd $ Iou with payer = bank; owner = alice; amount; viewers = []
  before <- queryContractId bob iouId
  assert (before == None)
  submitMustFail bob do exerciseCmd iouId Share with viewer = bob
  submitMustFail bank do exerciseCmd iouId Share with viewer = bob
  sharedId <- submit alice do exerciseCmd iouId Share with viewer = bob
  archived <- queryContractId bank iouId
  assert (archived == None)
  bobView <- queryContractId bob sharedId
  case bobView of
    None -> abort "Shared viewer cannot see IOU"
    Some iou -> do
      assert (iou.payer == bank)
      assert (iou.owner == alice)
      assert (iou.amount == amount)
      assert (iou.viewers == [bob])
  submitMustFail bob do exerciseCmd sharedId Share with viewer = carol
  sharedAgainId <- submit alice do exerciseCmd sharedId Share with viewer = carol
  bobAgain <- queryContractId bob sharedAgainId
  case bobAgain of
    None -> abort "Sharing again removed prior viewer"
    Some iou -> assert (iou.viewers == [carol, bob])
  carolView <- queryContractId carol sharedAgainId
  case carolView of
    None -> abort "New viewer cannot see IOU"
    Some iou -> assert (iou.viewers == [carol, bob])

  oldId <- queryContractId bank iouId
